title: Reentrant process output while instrumentation is active

environment.system_features: ACL GMP GNUTLS LIBSELINUX LIBXML2 MODULES NATIVE_COMP NOTIFY INOTIFY PDUMPER SECCOMP SQLITE3 THREADS TREE_SITTER ZLIB

mechanism: Process filters can run during waits initiated from Lisp; instrumentation must tolerate callbacks during an action.
hypothesis: A filter that calls `accept-process-output' while the process continues producing output can observe nested or at least interleaved output processing before the outer action returns.
minimal_fixture: One shell process that emits two lines with a short delay and one filter that waits inside the first callback.
predicted_behavior: The trace records process output arriving while the filter/action is active; recursive depth may be runtime-dependent.

independent_checks.name: action observed output before final completion

counterexample: Assuming no asynchronous callbacks occur until an operation returns hides race points.
derived_gym_requirement: Actions that wait for external output must repeat relevant consistency checks after waits and represent outcome_unknown where completion cannot be proven.
